unit: SD of bell curve; 1 = 0.1 sens at 800 DPI; + = faster

na.label: North America
na.note: 24 pros (United States and Canada). Median slightly above the overall pro median; NOT lower than APAC (Mann-Whitney z=0.07 vs APAC pooled).

br.label: Brazil
br.note: Brazil; lowest median but wide spread (one 1.5 outlier clamped to 0.7).

eu.label: Europe
eu.note: UK, Russia, Poland, Nordics, Iberia etc.; sits at the overall median.

mena.label: Middle East & North Africa
mena.note: Turkey 8 + Morocco 1. Turkey classified as Middle East (assumption); Turkish pros skew high. Weak.

kr.label: Korea
kr.note: Korean-born pros; median near overall. Includes one eDPI-800 outlier clamped to 0.7.

sea.label: Southeast Asia
sea.note: Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Cambodia; high-sens tail (f0rsakeN, cgrs, xccurate). Wide spread.

oce.label: Oceania
oce.note: No Oceania pros in the ProSettings list; no data, set to 0.

u16.label: Under 16
u16.note: Guess, no sensitivity-by-age data found. Young players lack settled settings; literature gives no direction.

16_19.note: Guess. Near the peak-speed ages; no data on sens.

25_29.note: Guess from literature: response-speed decline from ~24 (Thompson 2014, StarCraft 2) and speed-accuracy trade-off in older users.

30_34.note: Judgement from the same literature; direction of the effect on preferred sens is unproven.

35p.note: Judgement. Older users slow down to keep accuracy (Hertzum & Hornbaek 2010). Capped well below 0.4 because no gamer sens data exists.

glasses.label: Glasses
glasses.note: Literature: spectacle periphery is distorted and wearers shift to head turns over far eye movements, but no study links this to mouse sensitivity or its sign. Left at 0.

contacts.label: Contact lenses
contacts.note: No optical periphery distortion, but no sens data either. Left at 0.
